root: ^The man before you gives you an odd look, "Do you need something?" he asks in a pompous manner, seemingly offended by your presence.

choices: ^What do you think about the war?
identity: ^The man scoffs as if your very question itself was ridiculous.

b: ^He looks away from you with disdain "I am of the higher class, peasant. I should be known quite well by the gravel beneath me."
^"Don't you know who I am? Goodness, foreigners are so troublesome."

converse: ^The man's eyes widen, he gives you a very careful examination, head to toe.

b: ^"Why yes, the lady and I are soon to be wed. This is my dearly beloved so don't get any ideas."
^"And just who might you be to asked such a question? Direct your queries elsewhere."

ally: ^The man fixes up his attire, polishing himself off as he turns his attention back to you.

b: ^"I am but a humble servant of this fine village. A noble representation of its high class."
^"I am a high class noble, the picture of culture and sophistication."

war: ^The man stops what he was doing and gives you a serious look as he considers your question.

b: ^"This war is terrible. A tragedy that ails this land immensely."
^"Such matters are far below me and unworthy of recognition."
^"How presumptuous. Where we're going is none of your business."
^"We're off to a fancy event and we needn't spend much more time here."

who: ^The man's face reddens as he fumes a bit at your comment. "Why I never! Hmph" is all he can manage as he turns away.
late: ^"You rapscallion." He chuckles a bit. "Though I must agree that she is quite an unstoppable gal so no harm done for now."
applaud: ^The man tips his hat to you. "Yes, yes. Tis grand to be appreciated as such. Thank you, sir."
comfort: ^You nod in agreement, empathizing with the man. He offers you a solemn nod in return and the two of you silently contemplate the issue together.
answer: ^The man's act crumbles quickly as he shows he true colors, cowering before you. "W-Well if you must know we're off to a ball right now."
